0022600220.text: The Spurs (9-2, first in the Southwest and second in the West) arrive on a nine-game winning streak, having gone 5-0 on the road and 9-1 over their last ten, while the Bulls (1-8, 14th in the East) have lost seven straight and are 0-3 at home. San Antonio is without Devin Vassell (groin), Jayden Quaintance (knee, surgery) and Tobias Harris (calf strain), and Chicago is without Norman Powell (shoulder inflammation) and Tobe Awaka (back), with Caleb Wilson (hip soreness), Dailyn Swain (back) and Zach Collins (illness) listed as day-to-day and game-time decisions. The Spurs won both meetings in 2025-26, including a 129-114 win in San Antonio on March 30, and the teams have not yet played each other this season.
